records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Partners!
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Getting your team's tasks into Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the hardest part. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is getting a few of the team's real tasks in there rather than leaving them in a doc or chat thread.

When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first tasks with you.

Best,
Priya
